description: AESV3 (/R 6, /V 5) encrypted document, empty user password, /P -4 (all standard permission bits granted, including bit 5 'extract for any purpose' and bit 10 'extract for accessibility'). Extraction against this document should proceed normally with no permission-related diagnostic, since the extraction-permission bit is set.

oracle.method: poppler pdftotext (which auto-tries the empty password; independent third-party extractor, never PlumePdf); `qpdf --show-encryption` for the /P value and permission-bit summary.
oracle.notes: qpdf --show-encryption reports: R = 6, P = -4, User password = (empty), 'extract for accessibility: allowed', 'extract for any purpose: allowed', file encryption method: AESv3.
